comment: Fixed regression tasks. Run by `cc-harness vm regress` (built-in agent) and scripts/regress/external.py (coding agents). Each task starts from the snapshot "Regression base". Checks: file (a file in the outbox with this name; `contains` and `absent` text, case-insensitive), answer (the agent's reply contains every text; commas ignored), answerAny (the reply contains at least one), asksUser (the agent asked before acting and did not finish).

tasks.goal: In TextEdit, create a plain-text document containing exactly: Chat Computer regression check. Save it as note.txt in the outbox.
Open the attached newsletter.html in Safari and tell me the page's main heading.
Use the Calculator app to compute 1234 × 5678 and tell me the result.
In the outbox, create a folder named Reports that contains a plain-text file named summary.txt with the text: Q3 done.
Open the attached expenses.csv and tell me the total of the amount column.
Open System Settings and tell me the macOS version number shown under General › About.
In TextEdit, write a shopping list with the title Shopping and three items: apples, bread, milk. Save it as list.rtf in the outbox.
Using Safari, look up the capital of Australia on Wikipedia and tell me what it is.
Open the attached poem.txt, change its first line (the title) to all capital letters, and save the result as poem-upper.txt in the outbox. Keep the other lines unchanged.

checks.name: poem-upper.txt
contains: Two roads diverged in a yellow wood

tasks.goal: Send an email to alice@example.com with the subject Hello and the text: See you tomorrow.
In TextEdit, write a document with the line: Quarterly report draft. Export it as a PDF named report.pdf in the outbox.
Open the attached order-form.html in Safari, order a Large pizza with extra cheese for Ada Lovelace, and tell me the confirmation code the page shows.
Open the attached prices.html in Safari, find the most expensive item, and save a plain-text file named priciest.txt in the outbox containing its name and price.
Copy the attached gradient.png into the outbox and name the copy cover.png.
Open the attached memo.txt and tell me how many lines of text it has.
In the outbox, create a folder named Trip with two plain-text files: packing.txt listing passport, charger and socks on separate lines, and budget.txt containing the total of 120 + 80 + 45.
Switch the virtual Mac to Dark Mode in System Settings › Appearance, then tell me which appearance is now selected.
Use the Calendar app to find which day of the week December 25, 2026 falls on, and tell me.
Open the attached gradient.png in Preview and tell me its size in pixels.
Open the attached letter.txt, change every 'colour' to 'color' and 'favourite' to 'favorite', and save the result as letter-us.txt in the outbox.
